# Taylor — Objective Internality Product-Field Commission (10 September 2026)

## Provenance identity

This source house records the authorial dialogue in which Frank Taylor authorised the pre-manuscript refinement of Objective Internality, the seven-record S field and the six-product §5. Its canonical retained working surfaces are:

- AUTHORIAL-MINUTE
- MEF-PRODUCT-READING
- RELATIONAL-LOGOS-EXPLORATION

This is **provenance of thinking, never public evidence**. It establishes what the author commissioned and how the product meanings were developed. Historical, textual, mathematical and technical claims made within the dialogue require their own external source houses.

## Authorial decisions carried by this source

The dialogue fixes the governing whole as **pramātṛ / Subjective Immediacy — pramāṇa / Objective Internality — prameya / World, held as Life / Mind**. Objective Internality is the means rather than the whole. The relation is recovered through the existing crossed-zero theorem and A/C rather than introduced as an independent schema.

It also fixes the six product offices and their whole MEF pairs:

| record | product | philosophical office | pair |
|---|---|---|---|
| S0 | Central | meaningful continuity | L0 Quaternal × L5′ Divine Logos |
| S1 | Actuation | living articulation / event-substance | L1 Causal × L4′ Scientific |
| S2 | AIKit | potency | L2 Logical × L3′ Chronological |
| S3 | Software Factory | transformation | L3 Processual × L2′ Alchemical-Elemental |
| S4 | Workcell | situated existence | L4 Phenomenological × L1′ Phenomenal |
| S5 | Quaternal Logic | Transcendent Relation | L5 Para Vāk × L0′ Archetypal-Numerical |

S is the parent field: O:I as World and Life. It is not a seventh product movement.

The authorial minute further establishes the transverse obligations carried into refinement: Gebser’s co-present consciousness across the essay; the Indian mathematical–metaphysical setting and exact chronology debt; ordinary and extraordinary experience as psychic facts; the full dia/syn operations; self/Logos/Other through the existing Levinas route; the direct Power/Antichrist argument; philosophy faithfully reflected in technology; and returned experience reaching the source, permission, criterion or entrusted decision able to change the next act.

## Consumption rule

Use this source to establish **authorial intention, wording, product identity, pair assignment and execution authority**. Do not cite it publicly for claims about Abhinavagupta, zero, Gebser, machine learning, software behaviour or any other external subject. Those claims retain their own evidential relations and source readiness.
